title: Encountered backfill data we don't recognise: 21 1 127
body:
When I went to start a new sensor today, my Sensor Status now shows Sensor Failed 6 and no matter what I reset or restart (phone, app, sensor, bluetooth) the logs continually show 

Encountered backfill data we don't recognise: 21 1 127

xDrip keeps asking me for calibrations which aren't accepter and prompt the same log error.

comments.body: Also occasionally flashing "Encountered Raw Data Sanity Issue 0.374"

I'm having a similar issue today. My new sensor started to work with an initial calibration of more than 40mg/dl. after a couple of hours started to say "Confused Calibration 1", and on the log i have tons of "Enconuntered backfill data we don't recognise: 8 5 127 2019-06-08 18:06:18". I have restarted the sensor, switched on and off, even updated xdrip, but no way. Please any help?

Hi,

any thing we can try? how we can clean this backfill data from the transmiter?, i have stopped the sensor, and started it again with no success, i have waited with sendor stopped for hours no way. Thanks for any help.

Best regards.
I just got this now also on a galaxy s8 ruining android Pie with dexcom g6.  Anything I can do?

I am getting a very similar problem, backfill 21 1 127, with a brand new transmitter. Firmware version 2.18.2.88 serial starting 8G. I am running the latest nightly of xDrip 09.10 and the native G6 collector.

I am getting some 'could not read reply to Auth challenge' and 'could not read after authrequesttx'. Android version 9. No problems before change of transmitter today.
When I got this issue, I just left it alone and eventually it ended up calibrating OK.  I don't think it was anything I did -- it went away on its own, apparently.
Thanks for letting me know this jlecount. I will see if it sorts itself out overnight.

Sure.  I'd be curious to hear back from you if that's your experience too so we know I wasn't just an anomaly etc...Or maybe I did something that helped -- if so I don't recall anything other than ignoring it overnight.
Mine ended up doing the same, fixed itself after a while.

No improvement overnight. I stopped the sensor, waited 20 minutes and started again. "Sensor Failed 6". Lots of "could not reply to auth challenge" messages. I will try another sensor but I suspect there is something different about the transmitter. Perhaps Dexcom keep changing the firmware.

I seem to be having a similar problem with a 8Gxxx G6 transmitter, anyone ended up finding a way to fix this? Just opened a new issue on this here: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1100

In my case (September 12th) the cause of the error was mechanical - when peeling the sensor off after 24 hours, I found that no sensing element was present. It had not been introduced under the skin! Instead, it was still stuck in the white inserter contraption. This gave me the Sensor Failed 6, there was no glucose for the sensor to measure.

I have not encountered this problem with the dexcom before or since. I left it 24 hours before replacing the sensor because I assumed the insertion had worked and suspected I'd have an experience similar to others on this thread.
Interesting, thanks for the hint! I'm about to swap out the sensor too, it's been over 24hrs by now as well. Thanks again!

A fresh new sensor did the trick! I was a little hesitant to swap it out right away, before ruling out other issues, but about two days in we gave up hoping it would calibrate by itself eventually. It had a sensing element and some dried blood around it, so I think the insertion went alright. Not sure what could have caused for the sensor to be bad. We did go though multiple start/stop cycles on various phones, tried a different location the second time around, or maybe the sensor itself was faulty already 🤷‍♀

Glad to see you are back up and running.
